description: The line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8, with tick labels at each power of ten. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)," ranges from 94% to 100%, with tick labels at every 1% interval. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration of SepLLM. The purple line, marked with a triangle, represents SepLLM (n=64), the orange line with a square, represents SepLLM (n=128), the green line with a diamond, represents SepLLM (n=64, H), and the red line with a circle, represents SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The purple line starts at approximately 97% loss ratio at 1e7 TFLOPs and ends at around 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The orange line starts at about 96% and ends near 100%. The green line begins at approximately 97% and ends at about 99%. The red line starts at around 94% and ends at approximately 98%. All lines show a general trend of increasing loss ratio with increasing TFLOPs, with some fluctuations.
